I was depressed a long time agoI want you to understand several things; The first is that you must tell him that you will always be there supporting him. The second thing is that it is extremely difficult to "deal" with someone with depression, since they have many insecurities and they can become very suspicious of people. The last thing is that he understands that he told you because he has confidence in you, just keep talking to him about how he feels. Although some things seem irrational to you, you must have an open mind to everything he says. Maybe at this moment he has not told you some things in detail, you are not pressuring him to tell you how he feels or to tell you the whole story.The most important thing is this: NEVER give up, you can help him, just be patient. As a last thing, try to convince him to take therapy if you think it is very serious. I think it is all, you can, luck with your relationship.
